input.body: We are writing to request a review of a deduction of $11.80 on order UE-9a47, dated 2026-11-06, which was applied with the reason "wrong item" (the item named in the claim was "Fruit Bowl"). The order ticket for UE-9a47 lists only a Protein Bowl and does not list a Fruit Bowl [UE-9a47:ticket_omits_item]. Our records also show the order was ready at 18:20 and picked up at 18:22, a 2-minute interval between being ready and handoff [UE-9a47:pickup_handoff]. We are not making any claim about the contents of the bag beyond what the ticket shows. Based on the ticket, the item named in the claim was not part of this order. We respectfully ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
